changelog.note: Byte-identical extraction from PR #270 head. Verified: full batch rebuild reproduced all 76 dist files hash-identically; static QA 144/144.

Per-brand type systems via --font-display/--font-text vars + per-site site.css emission (defaults preserve next10 appearance). Optional long-form sections (services/area/faq) in build-pages. Verified tel/contact actions in the verify panel. qa.mjs expectations derive from config (N sites, domain allowlist, font floor) instead of the hardcoded batch of ten. qa-browser launch args for Chromium 1234+: --use-angle=swiftshader (–use-gl removed upstream) + --disable-gpu so static pages produce capturable frames; WebGL still renders via SwiftShader (verified webgl-ready on the fixture site).

Owner art-direction pass (2026-08-10 feedback): real business footer (brand/nav/verified contact/fine-print disclosure) replaces the verification-panel section and lab footer; official extracted logos render in header+footer with concept mark as labeled fallback; page titles are Name | City; font-metric-driven display masks (--display-line/--display-pad-top per pool family) fix tall-font clipping; pullquote/footer_line copy hooks; static QA gains dash ban, footer, and contact gates with the concept-mark check now conditional on an official logo.
